dark matter.label: dark matter
dark matter.definition: A metaphor for unseen historical forces whose presence is known only through their effects.

wind.label: wind
wind.definition: A natural force that may have influenced early human settlements and construction methods in Anatolia and Syria.

first civilization.label: first civilization
first civilization.definition: The period when human ancestors began cultivating land, building settlements, and establishing organized societies.

human transformation.label: human transformation
human transformation.definition: The shift in human behavior from isolated tribal life to organized, collaborative projects involving shared goals and labor.

invisible history.label: invisible history
invisible history.definition: The unrecorded, intangible aspects of early human life that are only inferred through physical remains and modern techniques.

dark matter of history.label: dark matter of history
dark matter of history.definition: The unrecorded, pre-literate period of human history that lacks written accounts or eyewitnesses.

dna sequencing.label: DNA sequencing
dna sequencing.definition: A modern scientific method used to analyze genetic material from ancient remains to understand early human populations.

aerial and light archaeology.label: aerial and light archaeology
aerial and light archaeology.definition: Archaeological techniques that use aerial imaging and non-invasive methods to detect ancient sites without excavation.

detritus.label: detritus
detritus.definition: Ancient physical remains such as stone, bone, and clay that provide traces of early human activity.

year 12026.label: year 12,026
year 12026.definition: A hypothetical starting point for human history, proposed to reflect the true beginning of civilization in the Holocene.

climate change.label: climate change
climate change.definition: Environmental shifts that may have influenced the development of early human societies and their collaborative efforts.

holocene epoch.label: Holocene epoch
holocene epoch.definition: The geological period during which human civilizations began to emerge, including the time of the first civilization.

karahan temi.label: Karahan Temi
karahan temi.definition: One of the first known villages in southern Anatolia and northern Syria where early human collaboration began.

year 0 of human history.label: year 0 of human history
year 0 of human history.definition: A hypothetical starting point in human history, set at 12,026 years ago, marking the beginning of recorded human civilization.

first great construction.label: first great construction
first great construction.definition: The earliest known large-scale human construction project, built with stone and wood, predating the pyramids.

sinterbedrock.label: sinterbedrock
sinterbedrock.definition: A stone construction material used in early human buildings, carved into t-shaped columns and decorated with animals.

fertility figurines.label: fertility figurines
fertility figurines.definition: Early human sculptures of birds or beasts, possibly representing religious or symbolic expressions of fertility and desire.

first religion.label: first religion
first religion.definition: An early form of belief system emerging from human desire to express inner worlds through ritual and art.
